# Privacy Policy for Taleria

**Last Updated:** December 30, 2024

Taleria ("we", "our", or "the app") is a children's storytelling application that generates personalized stories using artificial intelligence. This privacy policy explains how we handle information when you use our app.

## Information We Collect

### Information You Provide
- **Child Profiles:** Name, age, and gender (stored locally on your device only)
- **Story Preferences:** Selected themes, avatars, and story settings

### Automatically Generated
- **Stories:** AI-generated story content and illustrations

## How We Use Information

- To generate personalized stories based on profile settings
- To save stories locally for later reading
- To provide parental control features

## Data Storage

**All data is stored locally on your device.** We do not:
- Create user accounts
- Store personal information on our servers
- Track or collect analytics
- Use advertising

## Third-Party Services

Story generation uses third-party AI services. When generating a story:
- Story prompts (theme, character name, age) are sent to AI providers
- No personally identifiable information is shared
- Generated content is returned and stored locally

## Children's Privacy

Taleria is designed for children ages 2-9 under parental supervision. We comply with children's privacy protection principles:
- We do not collect personal information from children
- All data remains on the device
- Parents can delete all data at any time through the app

## Parental Controls

Parents can:
- Set a PIN to protect settings
- Block specific story themes
- Set daily screen time limits
- Delete profiles and stories

## Data Deletion

To delete all data:
1. Open the app
2. Go to Settings
3. Delete individual profiles, or uninstall the app

Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored data.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in the "Last Updated" date.
